metadata.name: West Altadena spread-model scenario
metadata.label: Scenario input, not a forecast
metadata.generator: scripts/spread_model.py (fast marching, elliptical wind-driven spread, spot fires)
metadata.claim: Conservative within our assumptions. Not validated against satellite data: MODIS and VIIRS fire detections are about 1 km and 375 m, intermittent, and blocked by smoke.
metadata.neverMarksSafe: Homes outside every front get an extrapolated arrival time, never 'safe'.
